en.title: Mississippi Midterm Accessibility Rule Takes Effect as Disability Advocacy Grows
en.summary: Mississippi’s midterm election accessibility requirements are now being enforced, marking a key policy shift for disability rights. AbleVu launched a contributor program linking education and workforce development, the MTA settled a long-running elevator accessibility lawsuit, and a survey highlights AI's potential to improve workplace and learning accessibility. Additionally, X introduced video autoplay settings to help users with sensory sensitivities.

highlights.title: Accessibility Cannot Be an Afterthought in Mississippi’s Midterm
AbleVu Bridges Education, Workforce Development, and Accessibility Through Growing Contributor Program
MTA and disability advocates settle long-running elevator accessibility suit
Survey highlights AI's potential to advance accessibility in work and learning

zh-TW.title: 密西西比州無障礙選舉措施生效
zh-TW.summary: 密西西比州中期選舉的無障礙要求現在開始執行，標誌著殘障權益政策的重要進展。AbleVu 推出連結教育與勞動力發展的貢獻計畫，MTA 與殘障倡議者達成電梯無障礙訴訟和解，且最新調查顯示人工智慧在工作與學習中的無障礙潛力。此外，X 平台推出影片自動播放設定以協助感官敏感使用者，並有日本帳號討論社會對殘疾的看法。

highlights.title: 無障礙不得成為密西西比州中期選舉的事後補救
AbleVu 透過成長中的貢獻計畫連結教育、勞動力發展與無障礙
MTA 與殘障倡議者解決長期電梯無障礙訴訟
調查顯示人工智慧有潛力提升工作與學習中的無障礙性
X 影片自動播放設定
日本社會對殘疾的看法討論
